messages:
mara: heads-up — eu-west canary failed during preflight. observed pod scheduling flaps after values merge. nodeAffinity split across charts.
deploy-bot: deploy failed: preflight check failed on 3/3 canary pods: CrashLoopBackOff
sahil: logs?
olga: looks like values overlay added `nodeSelector` and `affinity` in different hierarchies, kube couldn't satisfy both on nodes with `gpu=true` label
kevin: so rollout should pin to previous chart version or rollback the values merge? what's safer for prod window?
beth: change window is open for another 30m, but we shouldn't risk full rollout. recommend pin to chart v2.14.1 for stable nodes
mara: agree. plan: hold canary, pin `deployment.spec.template.metadata.annotations['helm.redwood/pinned']="v2.14.1"` and re-run canary with only chart bump (no values merge)
sahil: how to apply pin quickly? helm rollback or patch?
olga: simplest: `kubectl -n payments patch deployment payments-api -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"helm.redwood/pinned":"v2.14.1"}}}}}'` then `deploy-bot retry-canary --thread=3133337777`
mara: ok do that, also create a short release-note blurb: "Reverted values merge that introduced conflicting affinity; pinned chart to v2.14.1 for canary."
release-notes-bot: queued note: "payments: pin v2.14.1 - revert preflight failing values merge" :memo:
deploy-bot: retry triggered by mara at +2m. Canary run started: canary pods scheduling...
deploy-bot: canary progress: 3/3 ready in eu-west after pin — preflight passed
kevin: nice. next: open a follow-up PR to reconcile values hierarchy and add unit test for affinity merges. assign to olga
olga: will do. I'll also add an eval to Redwood Optimize to flag inconsistent affinity/value keys across charts
mara: closing thread: decision = pin + follow-up PR. tagging @oncall to monitor next 2h :eyes:
release-notes-bot: published draft note to /release-drafts/payments/3133337777
beth: thanks team :thumbsup:
